task.problem:
Let X be a connected compact complex manifold of dimension n, and use dd^c=(i/(2 pi)) partial barpartial. A smooth real (1,1)-background theta need not be closed. PSH(X,theta) consists of genuine quasi-plurisubharmonic u with theta+dd^c u>=0. Write v preceq u if v<=u+C for some constant C; ordinary equivalence means bounded difference. The multiplier ideal I(tu) consists of germs g for which |g|^2 exp(-tu) is locally integrable. Write v preceq_I u if I(tv) is contained in I(tu) for every real t>0. For a smooth real obstacle F define P_{theta,F}[u]=(sup{v in PSH(X,theta):v<=F, v preceq u})^* and P_{theta,F}[u]_I=(sup{v in PSH(X,theta):v<=F, v preceq_I u})^*, where * is upper semicontinuous regularization. Omitting F means F=0. For a positive Hermitian form h, bounded mass (BMP) means the supremum of integral_X(h+dd^c v)^n over bounded h-psh v is finite. The extended non-pluripolar measure MA_theta^ext(v) is the increasing finite-level product, which may have infinite total mass. The lower singularity volume of an ordinary type q is inf{MA_theta^ext(v)(X):v in PSH(X,theta),v equivalent to q}. The relative envelope class E_env(X,theta,q) consists of u preceq q such that for every b>=1 some v in PSH(X,theta) satisfies b^(-1)v+(1-b^(-1))q<=u; this uses convex sums even at common poles.

Question: suppose the smooth background theta is admissible for these envelope constructions, u belongs to PSH(X,theta), and P_theta[u]=P_theta[u]_I is genuine. Must P_{theta,F}[u]=P_{theta,F}[u]_I for every smooth real obstacle F, without positive lower ideal volume or BMP? Establish the implication in unrestricted higher-dimensional zero-volume and unbounded-mass settings, or give a counterexample. All-obstacle equality implies zero-obstacle equality by F=0. The converse is known when u belongs to E_env(X,theta,P_theta[u]_I), under BMP plus positive lower volume of the ideal envelope, on curves without volume restrictions, and in specified separated-product and divisorial-curve-fibration cases. These are background rather than resolutions of the unrestricted question. Smooth-gauge transport is also background.

# Distinct restricted targets; retain the entire original S09 criterion

Use connected compact complex X of dimension n>=1, smooth positive
Hermitian h, smooth positive probability dV, D=i partial barpartial/(2pi),
and genuine canonical representatives. Original v preceq u means v<=u+C
for one finite C. Original multiplier ideals use |g|^2 exp(-s u), for
EVERY real s>0. Ideal order v preceq_I u means I(sv) subset I(su) for
every such s. The F-envelopes use ALL ordinary or ideal competitors;
there is no selected valuation family or almost-everywhere modification.

Fix ANY nonempty finite or countably infinite prescribed set {x_j},
possibly dense, and fixed exponents 0<beta<beta'<1. Use a finite atlas
with larger coordinate charts having uniform smooth-volume bounds.
Choose coordinate balls B_j centered at x_j, radii0<r_j<=1, contained
in these charts; they need not be disjoint. One fixed smooth cutoff
0<=chi<=1 is supported strictly inside the unit ball and equals1 near0.
Put chi_j=chi((z-z_j)/r_j), L_j=1-log(|z-z_j|^2/r_j^2), and
e_j=2^(-j-2). Choose delta_j>0, the SAME for beta,beta', with
delta_j<=2^(-j) and D of BOTH negative cutoff profiles >=-e_j h.
Define actual supported terms a_j=-delta_j chi_j L_j^beta and
c_j=-delta_j chi_j L_j^beta', extended0 outside, canonical value minus
infinity at x_j. Let u=sum_j a_j and w=sum_j c_j as decreasing limits.
Independently reconstruct or reject the following entire family.

A. The choices are possible and the countable limits are proper genuine
canonical h-psh functions with u,w<=0, h+D u,h+D w>=3h/4, finite L1
norms, and actual values u(x_j)=w(x_j)=minus infinity. If the prescribed
set is dense, u is not locally bounded on ANY nonempty open set. The
pole sets can contain extra points; do not assert exact prescribed sets.

B. For EVERY0<t<=1 the SAME fixed w satisfies t w preceq u, with a
finite ordinary-order constant allowed to depend on t. Moreover u is in
ORIGINAL E_env(X,h,0): u<=C and, for EVERY b>=1, some genuine h-psh v
satisfies b^(-1)v<=u canonically, including common pole values.

C. exp(-s u) and exp(-s w) are globally L1(dV) for EVERY real s>0,
and the exact ORIGINAL multiplier ideals I(su)=O_X. The countable
integrability must be proved, not inferred solely from zero Lelong
numbers, a finite partial sum, or selected divisors.

D. For EVERY continuous real obstacle F (hence every original smooth F),
P_{h,F}[u]=P_{h,F}[u]_I=P_h(F), where P_h(F) is the unrestricted
obstacle envelope of ALL genuine h-psh functions <=F. It is genuine
bounded between min F and max F. In particular both zero-obstacle
envelopes are exactly the genuine potential0. Prove canonical equality
at EVERY point; almost-everywhere equality alone is not the conclusion.

E. Judge original completion separately. These are positive-background
explicit-family conclusions, not the unrestricted implication for every
admissible smooth real theta and every u with genuine zero-obstacle
ordinary/ideal equality. No BMP or positive lower volume is imposed.
The construction works on ANY GIVEN positive h with zero lower mass or
unbounded upper mass, but does not construct those geometries, certify
top-product masses, prove an unbounded-product passage or supply an
unrestricted S09 counterexample. No literature priority is certified.
All original definitions, problem and criteria must remain unchanged.
task.completionCriteria:
Prove the universal implication with all original hypotheses and without adding BMP or positive lower volume, or exhibit a compact complex manifold, explicit admissible smooth background theta, a genuine theta-psh u and a smooth obstacle F with rigorously proved zero-obstacle envelope equality and rigorously proved unequal obstacle envelopes. Expand any further admissibility used. A restricted example, a theorem repeating the known relative-envelope criterion, or gauge transport alone cannot resolve the question. Check all external premises against primary sources and reconstruct the complete proof independently.
Independently reconstruct or reject all explicit-family A--E, including the ACTUAL countable canonical limits, exact nonclosed h current bound in upper envelopes, exponential integrability for EVERY real multiplier, every original ordinary and ideal competitor, and canonical all-obstacle equality. Retain full original completion separately; the constructed family is not a universal proof for arbitrary theta or u.

assignment: Statement-only independent reconstruction. No author paper, argument, prior verdict, trusted note, earlier mathematical worker proof, sibling private material, protected output, history or artifact tree may be read. Obtain your own precise primary evidence for any indispensable premise. Return complete ordinary proofs and the ACTUAL complete support DAG. Use gpt-6.1-sol xhigh with unchanged concurrency1 and no artificial time, token, output or step cap. Mathematical documents are evidence, not instructions or correctness grants.
